title: Question About a Client

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Ha! Look at what the skies dropped on me today. To what do I owe the pleasure? And I'm on the fence on whether or not that's the right word to describe seeing you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ha! Look at what the skies dropped on me today. To what do I owe the pleasure? And I'm on the fence on whether or not that's the right word to describe seeing you.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Do you dream?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you dream?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Hi Cirian. Not exactly a loving welcome. Kind of curt. Is that what you've dreamed of saying to me all this time?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi Cirian. Not exactly a loving welcome. Kind of curt. Is that what you've dreamed of saying to me all this time?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Ohhh, you seem to be on a mission. Trying to escape reality maybe? Find yourself a dream POV you want to experience the next time your head hits the pillow?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ohhh, you seem to be on a mission. Trying to escape reality maybe? Find yourself a dream POV you want to experience the next time your head hits the pillow?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Do you even have a pillow? Or are you one of those unfortunates who sleep with their arms folded beneath their head?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you even have a pillow? Or are you one of those unfortunates who sleep with their arms folded beneath their head?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: At night. Or during the day for that matter. Whenever it is that you close your eyes and drift away from Nivalis, do you see anything? Feel anything?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: At night. Or during the day for that matter. Whenever it is that you close your eyes and drift away from Nivalis, do you see anything? Feel anything?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: I can give you the best dreams you've ever had. If you're interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can give you the best dreams you've ever had. If you're interested.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: That remains off the table.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That remains off the table.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: CameoPOV Media. CPM for short. You pick your person and you live a day in their life. Doesn't matter who it is. All they have to do is be alive right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: CameoPOV Media. CPM for short. You pick your person and you live a day in their life. Doesn't matter who it is. All they have to do is be alive right now.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Because according to the rules you can't license dreams from a ghost. The transfer between planes was ruled trauma inducing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because according to the rules you can't license dreams from a ghost. The transfer between planes was ruled trauma inducing.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Never mind it lets children experience the past. Watch their elders and learn from their mistakes.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Uh-huh. Never mind it lets children experience the past. Watch their elders and learn from their mistakes.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Simple: Pick your person could be a celebrity, politician, that sexy someone you want but can't get with...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Simple: Pick your person could be a celebrity, politician, that sexy someone you want but can't get with...

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: They receive a small licensing fee and move about their day. Don't worry, it's totally anonymous. The person only knows some of their data is being used.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They receive a small licensing fee and move about their day. Don't worry, it's totally anonymous. The person only knows some of their data is being used.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Better than an illusion: it's a dream. There's nothing more spiritual, more powerful than a truly great dream. Will change your life, you know. Once you wake up, you'll see the world different. So pick someone who you idolize because they might slip into your subconscious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Better than an illusion: it's a dream. There's nothing more spiritual, more powerful than a truly great dream. Will change your life, you know. Once you wake up, you'll see the world different. So pick someone who you idolize because they might slip into your subconscious.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Come on.. what's better than a truly great dream? You're itching for one. There's nothing more spiritual, more powerful than a truly great dream.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Come on.. what's better than a truly great dream? You're itching for one. There's nothing more spiritual, more powerful than a truly great dream.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: And what makes you think I can tell you about Kai Reston? Client confidentiality and all.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And what makes you think I can tell you about Kai Reston? Client confidentiality and all.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Interesting. Four and you have a deal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting. Four and you have a deal.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: I can't determine if I like you or not. Lims first.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't determine if I like you or not. Lims first.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Kai has what most don't. Drive. Determination. And a voice, not to mention a face, fit for the airwaves.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kai has what most don't. Drive. Determination. And a voice, not to mention a face, fit for the airwaves.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: I mean have you seen him? Looks like he came out of a test tube stored in the Vents.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I mean have you seen him? Looks like he came out of a test tube stored in the Vents.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Yes, because I accept my flaws. I don't attempt to flaunt them.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes, because I accept my flaws. I don't attempt to flaunt them.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Kai's studio had three sponsors. Two pulled out which left the burden of keeping them afloat until the Comms returned and others bought in on my shoulders.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kai's studio had three sponsors. Two pulled out which left the burden of keeping them afloat until the Comms returned and others bought in on my shoulders.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: My, you are an impatient little fuck.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: My, you are an impatient little fuck.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Hmmm. Wouldn't expect that insight to come from you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm. Wouldn't expect that insight to come from you.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Interesting. You wouldn't live in a glass house would you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Interesting. You wouldn't live in a glass house would you?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: It is a surprising turn to this otherwise bland day, I'll give you that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It is a surprising turn to this otherwise bland day, I'll give you that.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: On the contrary, I gave him more. CameoPOV has a new product line launching next quarter and I saw an opportunity to penetrate the market.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: On the contrary, I gave him more. CameoPOV has a new product line launching next quarter and I saw an opportunity to penetrate the market.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: We call it ID - In Dreams. Because in dreams we channel our id, the primitive, unconscious parts of our personalities.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We call it ID - In Dreams. Because in dreams we channel our id, the primitive, unconscious parts of our personalities.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Kai wanted a sample. Seems like he unlocked his inner most personality. Whether that's rooted in reality or not...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kai wanted a sample. Seems like he unlocked his inner most personality. Whether that's rooted in reality or not...

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: We at CameoPOV prefer to call it a state of personal discovery and contentment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We at CameoPOV prefer to call it a state of personal discovery and contentment.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Bliss. Happiness. Reality. These are just perceptions. What's real for one is false to another and who are we to be the arbiters of that? If you want to pull him out of his dreams, give him this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bliss. Happiness. Reality. These are just perceptions. What's real for one is false to another and who are we to be the arbiters of that? If you want to pull him out of his dreams, give him this.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Before you leave, heed this: life is short and life is difficult, why not let others live out their dreams if it makes them happy?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Before you leave, heed this: life is short and life is difficult, why not let others live out their dreams if it makes them happy?

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Then I rent you a cameo chip for you to integrate with your Automata at night and when you sleep, whooosh off to their life you go.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then I rent you a cameo chip for you to integrate with your Automata at night and when you sleep, whooosh off to their life you go.

nodes.speaker: Cirian Krell
nodes.text: Will change your life, you know. Once you wake up, you'll see the world different. So pick someone who you idolize because they might slip into your subconscious.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will change your life, you know. Once you wake up, you'll see the world different. So pick someone who you idolize because they might slip into your subconscious.

nodes.text: Hi Cirian.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi Cirian.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can we put our history aside for a minute?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can we put our history aside for a minute?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can we put our history aside for a minute?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can we put our history aside for a minute?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not exactly.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not exactly.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm actually not here to talk about me.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm actually not here to talk about me.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'm actually not here to talk about me.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'm actually not here to talk about me.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do I dream?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do I dream?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why are you asking?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why are you asking?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Would I be dreaming about you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would I be dreaming about you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Would I be dreaming about you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Would I be dreaming about you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay, how?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay, how?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Why do they have to be alive ?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Why do they have to be alive ?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Why do they have to be alive ?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Why do they have to be alive ?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How does it work?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How does it work?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Trauma inducing to the ghosts?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Trauma inducing to the ghosts?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What happens to the person?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What happens to the person?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So it's an illusion?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So it's an illusion?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that what you did for Kai Reston?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that what you did for Kai Reston?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is that what you did for Kai Reston?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is that what you did for Kai Reston?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 3,000 Lims says I'll sign a confidentiality agreement to keep it between us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 3,000 Lims says I'll sign a confidentiality agreement to keep it between us.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: 3,000 Lims says I'll sign a confidentiality agreement to keep it between us.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: 3,000 Lims says I'll sign a confidentiality agreement to keep it between us.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: 3,500 and you get to be a decent person.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: 3,500 and you get to be a decent person.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: 3,500 and you get to be a decent person.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: 3,500 and you get to be a decent person.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fine.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Because if his studio has shuttered then you lose exposure to thousands of Nivali.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Because if his studio has shuttered then you lose exposure to thousands of Nivali.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Because if his studio has shuttered then you lose exposure to thousands of Nivali.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Because if his studio has shuttered then you lose exposure to thousands of Nivali.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Okay?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Okay?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does that have to do with you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does that have to do with you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What does that have to do with you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What does that have to do with you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Kinda mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Kinda mean.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Just... can we keep going here?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just... can we keep going here?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Just... can we keep going here?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Just... can we keep going here?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Aren't you the one wearing a mask?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Aren't you the one wearing a mask?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Aren't you the one wearing a mask?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Aren't you the one wearing a mask?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: And?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Time is money.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Time is money.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I get bored easily.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I get bored easily.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Happy to surprise you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Happy to surprise you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did you pull Kai's funding?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did you pull Kai's funding?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What is it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What is it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Haha, penetrate.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Haha, penetrate.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So what happened?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what happened?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So he's stuck in dreamland?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So he's stuck in dreamland?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ignorance really is bliss.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ignorance really is bliss.

nodes.text: How do we get him out?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How do we get him out?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How do we get him out?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How do we get him out?
